## Type

- [ ] `feat` — new capability (question, template, document, agent, CLI command)
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — guides / README / manual
- [ ] `refactor` / `test` / `build` / `ci` / `chore`
- [ ] Breaking change (output path, frontmatter, CLI flag, or agent id renamed/removed)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate`, `npm run build`, and `npm test` pass locally.
- [ ] `dist/` is rebuilt and committed if `skills/` or `adapters/` changed.
- [ ] Frontmatter uses spec keys only. `description` is ≤ 200 chars, `SKILL.md` is < 500 lines, and it is the only `SKILL.md`.
- [ ] Templates stay tech-agnostic, and nothing makes the AI invent facts, versions, or compliance claims.
- [ ] Platform facts include **official source URLs** (listed below). Unverified facts are marked `UNVERIFIED`.
- [ ] New agent: `lib/agents.mjs` entry, guide in `docs/guides/`, and a matrix row in `docs/guides/README.md`.
- [ ] Guides, README, and `site/` are updated where relevant. The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`CHANGELOG.md` is generated by release-please).
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] No secrets or personal data. AI-assisted changes were reviewed by a human.
